oneLiner: Effortlessly split trip costs with friends, no spreadsheet needed.
problem: Group trips generate many shared expenses, and reconciling who owes what requires manual calculations or cumbersome spreadsheets, leading to errors and friction.
targetUser: Friends, families, and small travel groups who want a quick, transparent way to settle expenses after a shared trip.
coreFlow: Review settlement summary and finalize payments

screens.name: Trip Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides an overview of the trip, total spent, and status of settlements.

screens.name: Invite & Participants
screens.purpose: Allows the organizer to add friends via email or shareable link and set contribution preferences.

screens.name: Expense Entry
screens.purpose: Form to log each expense, attach receipts, assign payer, and choose split method (equal, percentage, custom).

screens.name: Settlement Summary
screens.purpose: Displays each participant's balance, suggested transfers, and options to export or copy payment links.

screens.name: Settings & Export
screens.purpose: Adjust currency, rounding rules, download CSV reports, and configure optional integrations.
